prerequisites: General issues of system design and limits of system design computer support.
Three approaches to automation of software system design: Formal methods.
Survey of analysis and design methodologies.
Methodology OMT, theory and examples of application.
Application and examples of UML for system analysis and design.
Application of OMT, UML in analysis and design of information and control systems.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand general issues of system design and limits of system design computer support.
Understand three approaches to automation of software system design: Formal methods, Methodologies and CASE systems, Heuristic and evolutionary approach.
Understand object oriented methodologies, specifically Methodology OMT, theory and examples of application.
Apply UML for system analysis and design with examples.
Understand CASE systems - principles and examples, specifically CASE system Rational Rose (1998-2002).
Apply OMT, UML in analysis and design of information and control systems.

syllabus_topics: UML (Unified Modelling Language) for description of Information systems.
Lexical analysis and class diagram synthesis.
UML state diagram and its synthesis.
Algebraic and a computational representation of the state diagram.
UML sequence diagram, scenarios and sequence diagram synthesis.
Activity diagram and Use Case diagram.
Computer Aided Software engineering (CASE), Code generation.
UML for Control System Analysis and Design, SysML.
Application. Topics and assignment of semester projects.
Formal Logic Approach to analysis and design.
Testing of semester projects. Conclusion of the semester.
